converter: Resonalyze-fork session, REW HTTP API GET /measurements/{id}/frequency-response (big-endian float32 magnitude, log-spaced from startFreq at ppo points per octave)
note: VW Passat B8 sedan (LHD), 2026-08-24: moving-microphone (MMM) RTA of each front driver alone and of three sums, taken to verify channel levels. Captured with the processor holding the 'levels only' variant of a Resonalyze plan for this cabin (left side -2 dB midbass, -4 dB midrange, -4 dB tweeter, scene offset 0 ms); the plan itself is not published here, it is not ours to publish. REW 5.40 Beta 132, 65536-point 1/48 octave RTA, Hann window, no smoothing, 150 averages per capture, microphone moved through the listening area during the averaging. An RTA carries no phase and no impulse response: nothing here is usable for delay, polarity or crossover work.
amplitude: dB SPL, REW's SPL calibration applied (splOffsetdB 102.3415355682373, the same calibration as the 2026-08-20 set); no smoothing, no microphone calibration file applied
